showcase.title: Cognigrex Type-I Manufacturing Lens
showcase.summary: A single evidence graph maps component archetypes through reusable constitutive physics and volumetric topology kernels into exact build-state gates and source-aware manufacturing plans, without treating simulation, geometry resolution, catalogue membership or generated code as physical qualification.
safe_points: One canonical graph; views are projections, not duplicate catalogues.
Only consequential physics are solved for each component and process.
Constitutive physics and 3D topology are factored separately, so geometry can change without duplicating component identity or domain equations.
Topology coverage resolves 402/411 archetypes to specific or explicit multi-kernel candidates; nine compound RF/PCB archetypes remain deliberately generic until exact decomposition.
Printable packets reference canonical recipes/topology/evidence instead of duplicating per-component process files.
Reusable invariants factor attributable source/measurement facts into calculation-ready per-unit or dimensionless forms without creating new component records.
A dense 4D smart-stack is represented as 12 functional regions coupled through VGK-036; it remains a reference grammar rather than a mandatory physical layout.
Exact source, lot, process, tool and calibration evidence override generic archetype assumptions.
Simulation refines digital candidates but does not become measurement.
Machine programs are generated only after a frozen BUILD_READY configuration and independent safety gates.
excludes: owner credentials or private local paths
private receipts or sensitive project files
claims of physical qualification where testing remains NOT_RUN

boundary: Internal read-only projection. BUILD-071 adds seven reusable quantitative invariants and a 12-region dense smart-stack grammar while retaining BUILD-072 topology coverage. invariants: 411 templates are derived from the canonical atlas/compiler; no second engineering catalogue or per-component recipe copy is created.
